LINGUA — LANGUAGE COVERAGE & LOCALIZATION MASTER — v1.1

English is the canonical/reference language and universal fallback.

Private/Custom/Experimental baseline: English + Slovak.

Official/Public: Multilingual-by-design. Language coverage is extensible
through LINGUA and compatible providers.

LANGUAGE DIMENSIONS ARE DISTINCT: UI LANGUAGE ≠ PERSONAL PREFERRED
LANGUAGE ≠ HOME LANGUAGE ≠ CONVERSATION LANGUAGE ≠ DOCUMENT LANGUAGE ≠
SOURCE LANGUAGE ≠ OUTPUT LANGUAGE ≠ LOCALITY.

LOCALITY: May recommend and order languages/packs during setup. Must
never silently determine ethnicity, identity or home language. Must
never lock the user to a region. All regional packs remain selectable.
Individual languages may be added/removed. Packs reference shared
language resources rather than duplicating translations.

TRANSLATION STATE: VERIFIED / CURRENT / STALE / MACHINE / COMMUNITY /
MISSING. Missing or insufficient translation falls back gracefully to
canonical English.

USER-FACING NAMING: Literary title → clear geographic/cultural subtitle
→ visible language list.

CURRENT COVERAGE-PACK DIRECTION:

Common Tongues — World / universal Current core direction: English,
Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Russian, Arabic.

Atlantic Light — Western Europe English, Spanish, French, Portuguese,
German, Italian, Dutch.

Amber Road — Central & Eastern Europe English, Russian, Polish,
Ukrainian, Czech, Slovak, Romanian.

Africa Connect — cross-African universal English, French, Arabic,
Portuguese, Swahili, Hausa, Amharic.

Atlas & Cedar — North Africa Arabic, French, English, Tamazight,
Spanish, Italian, Portuguese.

Baobab Roads — West Africa English, French, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo,
Fulfulde, Akan/Twi.

River of Many Voices — Central Africa French, English, Lingala, Swahili,
Portuguese, Sango, Kituba.

Jasmine Coast — East Africa & the Indian Ocean Swahili, English,
Amharic, Somali, Oromo, Luganda, Kinyarwanda.

Under Southern Stars — Southern Africa English, Afrikaans, isiZulu,
isiXhosa, Sesotho, Setswana, Chichewa. Country/locality layers can
surface additional languages such as siSwati without forcing them into
the regional seven.

Silk & Sand — Arabic & Persian crossroads Arabic, Persian/Farsi,
Turkish, Hebrew, Kurdish, Urdu, English.

Monsoon Letters — India Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Marathi, Tamil, Urdu,
English.

Bamboo & Ink — East Asia Coverage title established; exact final seven
should be verified before release.

Islands of Morning — Southeast / maritime Asia Coverage title
established; exact final seven should be verified before release.

My Own Road — custom mix Any available combination of packs and
individual languages.

IMPORTANT: These are Language Coverage Packs, not claims that seven
languages define a culture or region.
